execution_route: Shared core.flight.lease_cli worker lease plus a standalone core.flight.cli worker attached to the resident session, optionally launched as a Windows Scheduled Task with the battery and idle conditions disabled and no execution time limit (owner decision 24). No campaign, no scorer.

modules.base: the SEALED dual-store ANCHOR configuration (configs/baseline/slurp-native-dual-store-train-fold-a-anchor-v1.json): the complete native episode, the shared controller and FlightRuntime path, Reviewer-only task-contract tool authority, Solver-only answer authority, the three-candidate contract, the max512 resident geometry, the sealed Fold A speech-query segment vectors and the EVO-FOLDS-V2 promoted packets. Nothing of it moves. No node: no context_policy, no deliver_normaliser, no reviewer_audit.
modules.factor: native_episode.tool_schema_rendering, "per-role" (the key's ABSENCE, which IS the anchor's configuration) -> "constant". Item E17. Armed, every role contact of a row renders the same tools array -- the union of the schemas any role may call, which for this episode IS the Reviewer's own single saea-tool-task-contract-v1 array -- so the Reviewer's request bytes do not move and perception, solver and planner gain exactly one key, tools, with tool_choice still "none". AUTHORITY IS NOT WIDENED.
modules.purpose_is_throughput: PRIMARY DELIVERABLES are efficiency measurements -- prefilled prompt tokens per row, contacts per row, GPU hours per 1,080 rows, slot occupancy, utilisation, the per-position cache table and distinct_tool_schemas_sha256 == 1 on every row -- read from the sealed receipts, trace and server log. The official number is a NON-INFERIORITY GUARD, not a gain.
modules.second_declared_key_not_a_factor: native_episode.finite_completion_policy = "deliver-latest-or-abstain", required of every live SLURP native cell by scripts/checks/finite_completion_policy_check.py (item E13). It renders NO request byte and only decides whether a finite completion aborts the flight or the row is RETAINED with a terminal_disposition reason "finite_completion". The comparator side is provably unaffected: docs/receipts/slurp-finite-completion-exposure-v1.json proves zero finite completions on the sealed anchor.
modules.zero_added_contacts: the key changes what three of the five contacts render, never how many there are, so the bounded ceiling stays 11 and every ceiling is the anchor's registered ceiling, unchanged

prepared_phase_supply.note: THIS CELL'S OWN artifact, built model-free under its own run id by core.flight.cli prepare-supply in this registration. Its Perception output was asserted by hand against the sealed anchor preparation's own output and matched exactly, which is the model-free proof that neither declared key moves a knowledge-selection byte. core.flight.repin will find this pin VALID and rebuild nothing. --allow-output-change must never be passed.

quality_read_gate: The four-row smoke is STRUCTURAL AND EFFICIENCY ONLY and is never scored: delivery and contact counts, the saea-native-tool-schema-rendering-v1 receipt with distinct_tool_schemas_sha256 == 1 on every row, the Reviewer requests byte-identical to the sealed anchor's on the same four sample ids, the other roles' payloads differing in exactly the tools key, the request-fit receipts, any retained finite_completion row reported rather than treated as an error, the per-role authority refusals reported, and -- the point of the smoke -- the server-reported cached-token share per position showing the first-Reviewer and Planner contacts no longer re-prefilling the packet. No scorer, no answer, reference or quality interpretation and no task-quality claim.
